title: Slovakian Buckwheat Bowl with Adrenaline
description: A hearty bowl of Slovakian-style buckwheat with a spicy kick, perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes, or until softened.
Add the buckwheat groats and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cover the skillet with a lid.
Cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the buckwheat is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve the buckwheat hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream, a sprinkle of parsley, and a few slices of red pepper.
If desired, add a few dashes of hot sauce for an extra kick.
